name: Recipes
description: Desktop-automation recipes: record → save → replay UI action sequences. Backed by Ghost's RecipeStore, so it declares Ghost as a dependency and the graph refuses to disable Ghost out from under it.

hook_events.title: Desktop recording finished
hook_events.description: Fires when a recording session is stopped (POST /api/recipes/record/stop) and the captured action sequence has been turned into an editable recipe draft. The draft is NOT persisted anywhere — `save` is a separate, later call — so it travels in the payload: a consumer that wants to refine or install it must take it from here. Fires once per session; a session that is never stopped never fires. If the draft would push the payload past Core's event-size cap, it is omitted and `draft_omitted: true` is set — the event still fires, so a subscriber learns the recording ended and can tell the draft was shed rather than empty.

hook_events.title: Recipe replay succeeded
hook_events.description: Fires when a recipe finished replaying against the native desktop without erroring. Carries ghost's structured run result (per-step success/timing), which is the only place that detail exists — nothing persists a run record. Fires once per replay, so a recipe run on a schedule fires on every run.

hook_events.title: Recipe replay failed
hook_events.description: Fires when a replay could not complete: ghost is unreachable, the recipe is missing, or a step's target could not be found on screen. `error` is the same message the caller received. A replay raises either this or `replay.ended`, never both.

payload_example.error: recipe replay failed: no element matching 'New issue' in Linear
